rachel: Kicking off migration mig_2026_05_userflags_smallbatch in 03:00-04:00 PST window. Adds nullable user_flags jsonb. Canary at 03:10. Runbook attached to thread.

deploybot: queued migration mig_202605 (id: mig-202605). Canary holdpoint created at 03:10. Controls: /deploy abort 1711400123, /deploy update 1711400123 --param=value.

tom: Suggested defaults after last run: batch_size=3000, jitter_pct=10, concurrency=3, sleep_ms=100. We'll write progress into backfill_progress table to resume if needed.

deepak: I'll expose /ops/replica/hold endpoint. Replica hold triggers when lag >30s; token shared to oncall.

sara: Runbook SQL snippet to include in incident bundle:
```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;
-- batched update loop (psql):
UPDATE users SET user_flags='{"flags":[]}' WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 3000);
SELECT pg_sleep(0.1 + random() * 0.1);
```

tom: Pin canary fleet to app tag v2.3.3-canary so older hosts don't read new column. Notify frontend owners.

rachel: Rollback triggers: p95 +10% for 10m, error rate +2% abs for 5m, replication lag >45s for 5m, deadlocks >=4 in 10m. On trigger: /deploy abort 1711400123, snapshot progress, notify apps, run revert plan. Owner: rachel.

deploybot: config applied for 1711400123: batch_size=3000, jitter_pct=10, concurrency=3, sleep_ms=100. Start 03:00, canary 03:10.

opsbot: Canary holdpoint reached 03:10. Awaiting /deploy continue with soft-verify results.

rachel: Soft-verify ran at 03:13: sample 1000 rows, 0 mismatches, no p95 regression. Proceeding with /deploy continue 1711400123.

tom: During ramp observed replica lag spike to 52s at 03:28; triggered /ops/replica/hold which paused batches. Lag recovered to 9s within 3m; resumed with reduced concurrency=2. No abort.

rachel: Migration finished for small-tenants at 03:50; big-tenant COPYs still running but not blocking. Uploaded perf diffs and progress snapshot to /var/backfill/mig_202605/. Creating retro ticket for tuning. Thanks all.
